zh-CN.title: 官方账号启用全身动态人物原型
items: 官方账号改为无脸全身人物，不再使用头像式表情组件
头部、躯干、披风和两段式四肢独立分层，形成可扩展的角色骨架
人物方向、行走步态、披风摆动和点击招手会与广场交互同步

en.title: Full-body animated prototype for official accounts
items: Official accounts now use a faceless full-body character instead of an avatar expression widget
The head, torso, cape, and articulated limbs form an extensible layered character rig
Direction, walking gait, cape motion, and tap-to-wave feedback now follow plaza interactions
